dataset.dedup_rule: same run and frame, both boxes IoU >= 0.9; the crop uses the first profile's boxes in the order Broader, Stricter, Fast

d_hypothetical_if_reviewer_accepted_ever.note: Hypothetical: every pair with forklift=no or person=no removed before pair scoring on the 9 scorable primary runs. The application never removes candidates.

e_description_audit.sampling: 20 test items drawn with random.Random(20261020).sample over the sorted item ids, after the model run
e_description_audit.criteria: error = clear factual error: wrong object, or an invented action or object; minor = imprecise position or attribute; ok = no clear factual error (hedged speculation such as 'possibly' is not counted as an error)

f_timing.seconds_scope: per crop, model generation only; excludes the one-time model load
f_timing.machine: Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10700 CPU @ 2.90GHz, 8 cores / 16 threads, WSL2 Linux 6.6, CPU only
f_timing.concurrent_load: 1-minute load average 1.6 before the run and 11.2-14.1 during it; the Look process itself used about 11.6 cores (1158% CPU), so other jobs added roughly 0-2.5

per_candidate_group_as_app_runs.note: The application checks one key pair per candidate group (evidence frame closest to the peak, then the closest pair). Mapped onto the same test answers.

look_v3.notes: 4 overhead reach trucks answered forklift=no; 1 person=no on a visible person; 2 outputs with person='standing' (parse errors)

development.decision_rule: Keep look-v3 only if its exact-match count (both fields parsed and equal to the visual label, parse errors count as misses) over the same 39 dev crops is greater than 23 AND it confirms at least 15/17 true-forklift crops; otherwise restore look-v2.
development.note: look_v2 shelf_rack_flagged is 6/22 (22 shelf/rack crops); an early record said 6/26 by miscount.
